theme.statement: whether a recipe is better followed exactly, or treated as a starting point to depart from

own_opinion: A recipe is best treated as a reliable starting point: follow it closely when technique and proportions matter, but feel free to adjust seasoning, ingredients, and presentation to suit your taste and circumstances.
